Hi, I'm Akash.

I'm a social media marketer from Kolkata. During a four-month internship at Sao Digital, I ran day-to-day social media for small businesses in finance, healthcare, publishing and childcare.


My work covers the full cycle: researching the business, writing creative briefs for designers and editors, taking posts through client approval, scheduling weeks ahead, and reporting on what worked.


I studied B.Com (Hons.) in Accounts at Prafulla Chandra College, so I'm comfortable with numbers, budgets and reports.

How I work

A post is only finished when the client has approved it and it's live.

  1. ResearchLearn the business, audience and industry before writing a word.
  2. BriefWrite the exact on-graphic copy, layout, colours and caption for designers.
  3. ReviewSend posts through a client approval portal and manage revisions.
  4. ScheduleLoad content three to four weeks ahead on a steady cadence.
  5. ReportTrack results across platforms and adjust the next cycle.

Case study: early learning centre

Helping a local childcare centre get found

The challenge

A new early learning centre needed local visibility and a social presence on Facebook, TikTok and Google.

What I did

  • Built a content mix of warm, educational posts, including a Māori-language waiata reel.
  • Wrote a frame-by-frame storyboard for a 7-second video ad, with timings, footage style and animation direction.
  • Scheduled content across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Google Business Profile.

Case study: children's publishing

Turning a press feature into the top post

The challenge

A small publisher needed to reach parents of tween girls with a sensitive, trust-led message.

What I did

  • Planned a mix of educational posts, product posts, testimonials, carousels and short videos.
  • Used parent reviews and a regional newspaper feature as social proof.
  • Coordinated static, carousel and short-form video through monthly cycles.

Real stories and local proof outperformed generic educational graphics.

Case study: financial services

Clear content for a regulated industry

The challenge

An Australian financial planning firm needed trustworthy, jargon-free LinkedIn and Facebook content on retirement, super and investing.

What I did

  • Wrote briefs with exact headline, bullet points, footer details and two imagery options.
  • Kept visuals on-brand: clean, reassuring and professional.
  • Scheduled posts in OneUp on a Monday, Wednesday and Friday rhythm.

Strategy projects

Course projects using public information. They are practice work, not client work.

Course project

Just Herbs: a social strategy to turn followers into a community

Just Herbs had around 250K Instagram followers but low engagement, with under 100 likes on most posts.

  • Audited five platforms: Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube and Pinterest.
  • Built a 3-month plan with per-platform KPIs.
  • Created the #MyHerbalRitual 21-day wellness challenge, with a goal of 500+ user-generated entries.
  • Planned a full 30-day June calendar with CTAs, KPIs and repurposing for each post.

Public data, Feb to Apr 2025.

Course project

AwayTravel: a 3-month plan across organic, influencer and paid

  • Organic: three campaigns, Pack More See More, Built to Explore and Style Your Journey, each built around user-generated content.
  • Influencer: five creators chosen for engagement and fit, not follower count.
  • Paid: a Meta conversion campaign with a ₹20,00,000 budget.

Retargeting₹8,00,000Convert warm visitors

Targets: ROAS 4 or more, CTR 2.5% or more, CPC ₹8 or less.

Targets are planning goals, not real results.

Course project

Zepto: what its own social data says about carousels

  • Instagram engagement rose 40.8% to 126K, and carousels beat reels (56.5K vs 9.3K on top posts).
  • Facebook engagement fell 28.1% despite regular posting, and YouTube output dropped to a single video.
  • Blinkit posts about 13 times a week, against Amazon Fresh at about 7.

I proposed a #ZeptoSavedMyPlans remix campaign, three offline and AR activations, and 5 to 7 high-impact posts a week.

Public data as of mid-2025. Not affiliated with Zepto.

Course project

GoDigit: 7-email nurture funnel

  • Built a squeeze page, a 7-email Brevo sequence (welcome, pain point, education, social proof, FAQs, scarcity, cross-sell) and a sales page.

Course project

GA4: finding the leak

  • Analysed Google's demo merchandise store: about 46,000 users in a month, with a near-total drop between page view and purchase.
  • Flagged a product with 1,596 views and 329 add-to-carts but zero purchases, and recommended fixes.

Uses Google's public demo data.
